description:
# Context

The listen worker currently repeats too much turn-one context across the brief, the prompt, and the instruction payload. This fixture keeps a long narrative body so the renderer has to compact it instead of echoing the entire issue body back to the agent.

## Proposed Approach

- Keep the brief focused on ticket identity and reusable codebase references.
- Keep the turn-one prompt focused on live execution metadata plus one compact narrative summary.
- Keep first-turn instructions in exactly three logical blocks.

## Risks

- Over-compacting the prompt could hide actionable detail that only lives in the narrative body.
- Reordering attachment or discussion output nondeterministically would make regression tests brittle.
- Touching continuation behavior would silently regress resumed turns.

## Validation

- `cargo test --lib`
- `cargo test --test listen -- --test-threads=1`

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Narrative no longer appears in full across multiple turn-one surfaces
- [ ] Continuation behavior stays unchanged
